entities.summary: Philemon Pearce Dumasile Nokwe SC OMSG(13 May 1927, Evaton – 12 January 1978), known as Duma Nokwe, was a South African political activist and legislator, and served as the secretary-general of the African National Congress from 1958 to 1969.
